cards.title: Raising a Child With Ultra-Rare Genetic Disorder
cards.body: A parent shares their journey raising a daughter born with an ultra-rare genetic condition affecting just 1 in 163 million people. After decades in film PR, they've shifted focus to the biggest campaign of their life: fighting for their child's survival.

cards.title: Teaching Life Skills Before University
cards.body: Middle-class parents often neglect teaching essential domestic skills like laundry and cooking before their children leave home. These practical abilities become crucial when teens enter university halls unprepared.

cards.title: Parenting in the Suburbs: Finding Connection
cards.body: A family's move to suburban Melbourne initially felt bleak until they discovered vibrant community activities and social opportunities. They learned that suburban life offers different kinds of excitement when you know where to look.

cards.title: The Pre-University Shopping Reality Check
cards.body: An Ikea trip to furnish a child's university room becomes a moment of parenting truth about what domestic wisdom has actually been passed on. The author discovers just how unprepared middle-class teens often are for independent living.

cards.title: Postpartum Psychosis: When Mental Health Systems Fail
cards.body: The Lindsay Clancy case highlights the severe dangers of postpartum psychosis when proper mental health support is unavailable. Understanding this condition is critical for parents and healthcare providers.

cards.title: Parenting a Child With Schizophrenia
cards.body: A father shares his experiences and advice for navigating the profound sacrifices involved in raising a child diagnosed with schizophrenia. His perspective offers practical insight and emotional support for other families facing similar challenges.

cards.title: Missing Three-Year-Old Noah Woods Found
cards.body: Police divers recovered the body of three-year-old Noah Woods in a pond after he went missing from a playground. The discovery marked the tragic end to a search that devastated the community.

cards.title: Boy Abducted by Mother Finds New Purpose
cards.body: Alex Batty, who was abducted by his mother at age 11 in 2017, has found renewed purpose through employment. His recovery journey demonstrates the resilience possible after family trauma.
